newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro - stock market hopes too high.
newsitem.headline: Metro - stock market hopes too high.

text.p: Klaus Wiegandt, chief executive of Metro, Europe's largest retailer, said on Wednesday stock market expectations for the company's share performance were too high.
Metro shares were trading at 224.50 marks at midday, up from 216.40 marks at Tuesday's close, and from 120 marks at the start of the year.
Metro - stock market hopes too high
A spokeswoman for the Association for Protection of Securities Holders said Metro shareholders had no complaints.
"For us this is a happy development," said the shareholder advocate.
Goldman Sachs on Wednesday raised its rating of Metro shares to "market outperformer" from "market performer".
